answer: At dawn of every epoch each new identity pays a sybil tax: a 50 POA entry fee burned on the spot, never refunded. The fee funds a trellis of random mutual audits — every agent is checked by two strangers, and a failed check burns another 50 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA, all burned for zero reward. One honest agent pays a single 50 POA fee, keeps its earnings, and after 20 clean epochs earns an opal badge worth 25 POA.
